commands.toggle: Peek: switch the hover inspector on or off

tools.inspect: Inspects one element as the Peek tooltip shows it: tag, id, classes, size (CSS and device pixels), colours and WCAG contrast with its level, declared and rendered font, box model, role and accessible name. Give a CSS selector or a viewport point x/y (CSS pixels); without a target every view is inspected.

enabled.label: Peek inspector
enabled.description: Holding the modifier over an element shows its size, colours and contrast, font, box model, role and name.
enabled.help: Holding the modifier key over an element shows its size, colours and contrast, font, box model, role and name in a small panel. When off, it switches the inspector off.

modifier.label: Modifier key
modifier.description: The key held while hovering: Alt, Ctrl or Shift. Ctrl+Alt is AltGr on many layouts and is not offered. Takes effect in pages loaded after the change.
modifier.help: The key held while hovering to peek: Alt, Ctrl or Shift. Ctrl+Alt is AltGr on many layouts and is not offered. Applies to pages loaded after the change.

syncHighlight.label: Outline in every view
syncHighlight.description: The inspected element is outlined in the other views too, where it exists.
syncHighlight.help: The inspected element is outlined in the other views too, where it exists, so you compare it across breakpoints. When off, it outlines it in one view.

showBoxModel.label: Show the box model
showBoxModel.description: Draws the element's margin, border, padding and content in colour.
showBoxModel.help: Draws the element's margin, border, padding and content in colour while peeking. When off, it shows the numbers only.

tooltip.name: Name
tooltip.locked: Locked - Esc or a click elsewhere releases it
